source.title: Hirzek
source.description:
That quilboar you saw in your vision; I believe it was Hirzek.

The Earthen Ring has known of the Quilboar's crude version of shamanism for some time. However, there are rumors that a few have recently been making troubling strides. Hizrek is one such Quilboar.

From what you saw, it seems he is enslaving elementals, rather than cooperating with them as you and I would. No doubt this is causing distress among the elemental plane.

You must stop him, <name>. For the good of Shamans and elementals alike.
source.objective: Slay Hirzek at Blackthorn Ridge, Barrens, and bring his staff to Jen'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
source.progress: Hirzek's actions are an insult to the shamanistic ways, and the very elements themselves. He must be stopped.
source.completion:
<Je'neu takes the staff into his hands.>

You've done a great deed, <name>. I am relieved to know Hirzek's tortures have come to an end. Though, I fear he may be merely a symptom of a greater disease. So many elementals of Azeroth still call out in anguish.

Many questions remain to be answered; perhaps more than when we started. Nonetheless, I thank you for your service to the Earthen Ring.
